## Page 11

OUR PLANT
Production Line
From an early factory dedicated to the
production of generic drugs, the Company
has continued developing its manufacturing
capabilities, enabling the factory to produce a
broad spectrum of health products including
modern medicines, generic and new generic
drugs, herbal medicine, cosmetics, dietary
supplements among many other things.
BLC Research CenterThe company has established the BLC Research Center to
foster innovation and technological development for its products,
aiming for stable business growth. This center facilitates the
commercialization of research by collaborating with various Thai
state and private research agencies and universities. A key focus
is integrating traditional Thai knowledge with scientific research
and modern technology to develop herbal products, thereby
increasing competitiveness and ensuring sustainable business
expansion.
Laboratories
Laboratories have played a key role in controlling the quality of
products and the continued success of Bangkok Lab & Cosmetic
Public Company Limited since its founding.
The Company has stressed the importance of designing each
laboratory to enable the convenient and safe performance of
functions and minimize environmental impacts. The labs also
provide controlled conditions appropriate for each testing
condition to ensure precision and reliability.

Q4/25 Net Profit Performance
Net profit for Q4 2025 was 39.2 million Baht, with a net profit
margin of 9.6%.
Margin declined from 13.0% (4Q2024) and 10.0% (3Q2025)
primarily due to intensified brand-building/advertising efforts,
accrued employee expenses, and tax advisory fees.
EBIT dropped as short-term investment interest decreased
(funds were utilized for the new production facility and
Ratchaburi plant machinery).
This was partially offset by lower finance costs (from loan
repayments) and decreased tax expenses (reduction in non-
deductible entertainment items).
YE/2025 Net Profit Performance
Net profit for YE/2025 was 176.3 million Baht, with a net
profit margin of 10.6% (declined from 11.3% in 2024).
Revenue grew from partner and customer base expansion,
but was offset by higher operating expenses driven by
strategic brand-building investments.
EBIT slightly declined by 0.7% due to lower interest income
from short-term investments.
Finance costs dropped significantly (due to loan
repayments), but the effective tax rate increased to 20.4%
from higher non-deductible entertainment expenses.
